operator_stimulus.epistemic_status: instruction to register the proposition; not authorization to mark it verified

coherence_obligation: Global route/comparison compatibility: dependence of lifted source words on group elements, versus a retained central Z2 extension.
problem: Do the actual source-group relations permit global spin-lift sign choices, or is a central sign intrinsically required even after coordinate-frame transport?

definitions.G_p: Subgroup of SO(3) generated by the retained proton source rotations in the verified native Cartesian frame.
definitions.G_n: Subgroup of SO(3) generated by the retained neutron source rotations in the verified native Cartesian frame.
definitions.rho_s: The actual source representation G_s -> SO(3), not an arbitrary representation of an abstract group with the same name.
definitions.pi: Spin double cover SU(2) -> SO(3), evaluated by the action U E(v) U*=E(pi(U)v).
definitions.extension: Gtilde_s={(g,U) in G_s x SU(2): pi(U)=rho_s(g)}, with (g,U)(h,V)=(gh,UV).
definitions.section: A group homomorphism sigma_s:G_s -> Gtilde_s satisfying q_s composed sigma_s=id_G_s.

bold_conjecture.neutron: There exists a section sigma_n of q_n.
bold_conjecture.proton: There does not exist a section sigma_p of q_p.
bold_conjecture.quantifiers: Exists sigma_n in Hom(G_n,Gtilde_n) with q_n sigma_n=id; for every sigma_p in Hom(G_p,Gtilde_p), q_p sigma_p differs from id.

rivals: Both actual source extensions split after appropriate generator sign choices.
Checking only each generator's order suffices, even when mixed source relations fail.
A nontrivial cocycle in one section proves nonsplitting without testing whether sign redefinitions remove it.
required_source_checks: Validate inherited source hashes and derive the source multiplication tables from the actual retained rotations.
Verify the A4/C3 identifications from actual source data; group size alone is not an isomorphism certificate.
Verify pi(U)=rho_s(g) for the retained transported spin matrices and preserve the actual coefficient-action attachments.
Use the full pullback extension, not only the subgroup generated by one arbitrarily chosen list of positive lifts.
risky_tests: Construct an explicit normalized neutron section and verify sigma(gh)=sigma(g)sigma(h) for every source pair.
Give a proton nonsplitting certificate invariant under ALL normalized sign changes of a section, or equivalently a complete generator-sign search covering every possible section.
Export a concrete proton source identity word with lifted value -I, together with the argument that no sign assignment removes every such residual.
Verify normalized cocycle and triple associativity equations if a cocycle certificate is used; distinguish changes of section from changes of the extension.
Negative controls must reject an incorrect neutron sign choice, a sign-erased proton witness, and a certificate based only on abstract group labels.

test_plan.next_action: Consume the source-specific section/nonsplitting certificates. No physical selection or original-root closure follows.
test_plan.acceptance: Source-verified group identifications, explicit neutron section, exhaustive or gauge-invariant proton nonsplitting certificate, and deliberate-failure controls all pass.
test_plan.falsifier: An actual-source proton section exists, no actual-source neutron section exists, or an asserted source identification/lift attachment fails.

disposition.proton: nonsplit: zero sections among2048 normalized sign choices; invariant involution obstruction

scope: Finite source-group representations on explicit doublet candidates with previously verified coordinate transport. No physical particle identification, spin preparation, charge/magnetic/internal coupling law, topological filling, primitive cost or mass relation.
